propositions: [operator-attested] evidence contract demands provenance of the attestation event but not of the measurement context (environment, principal, privilege level), allowing escapes where measurements from wrong environments or under broader privileges are recorded as settled fact

measurement provenance must be declared as a mandatory continuation line under [operator-attested] items with four required fields (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) plus justification, enforced deterministically for presence and shape with no LLM judgment of correctness

an AGENT-tier LLM criterion (project.measurement-provenance) must verify declared environment against in-repo IaC anchors (e.g., Terraform backend account), flag privilege_posture=broader on scoped-permission criteria, and distinguish instruments (live-call vs simulation) for authorization claims, where simulations cannot refute actual API behavior

placeholder values (TBD, <angle-bracketed>, empty, N/A, ?) are rejected at the deterministic check layer so incomplete declarations do not ship as silent omissions, converting undeclared provenance into a recorded reviewable assertion

the new criterion routes via .rebar/ project overlay as advisory (never blocking), with trigger limiting cost to plans containing [operator-attested] tags and with execution_mode=agentic to enable filesystem tooling for repo contradiction detection

existing [operator-attested] criteria predating the contract amendment are grandfathered with coaching-only advisory flagging (no blocking) so tickets claiming and closing before this change are not migrated
